messages:
ara: need a late-night micro-burst for a throughput smoke tonight 23:30 PT. ~6 GPUs for 90m. can we squeeze this into the standby window?
samir: how flexible on region? uswest2 or eu-west? also please include charge code + owner.
ara: prefer uswest2 (lower egress), but will accept eu-west if uswest2 capacity is tight. owner me, charge code TBD.
ops_kai: i can try to shepherd this. uswest2 current hot A100 spare: 3. eu-west hot A100 spare: 2, plus 4 preemptible A100. we could do a hybrid: 3 hot uswest2 + 3 preemptible eu-west if cross-region latency is acceptable.
diane: cross-region mix will likely skew latency numbers. if this is a throughput smoke (not latency-sensitive) that's ok. if you're validating single-region QoS, we should keep it in one region.
ara: it's throughput-focused; cross-region fine as long as we note it in ticket. will record regional breakdown.
samir: ops_kai, can you run the quick probe and create the reserve request? alloc-bot: please probe.
alloc-bot: running availability probe... snapshot: uswest2: 3 hot A100, 0 preemptible; eu-west: 2 hot A100, 4 preemptible. recommendation: short reserve 3 hot in uswest2 + borrow 3 preemptible in eu-west.
ops_kai: created ticket INF-7902. payload in ticket: team=inference-platform; window=2026-03-21 23:30-01:00 PT; resources=6x A100 (3 hot uswest2 + 3 preempt eu-west); owner=ara; charge_code=placeholder. status=pending-approval.
ara: thanks. tagging @diane for approval once finance confirms charge code. will abort if we don't get confirmation 30m before window.
diane: noted. small ask: add a route label to keep traffic within the same AZ when possible. avoids cross-az egress.
ops_kai: added route label comment to ticket.
alloc-bot: reserve request INF-7902 moved to pending-reserve. expected notify at T-30m.
samir: quick code ping: PR #4437 tweaks the standby picker to prefer nodes with label `gpu_tier:burst`. would love a quick review before tonight.
ara: will glance now.
diane: looks fine to me, minor nits.
ara: closing loop: will post final charge code in ticket in 10m. if finance denies, we drop to 4 GPUs and shorten window to 45m.
alloc-bot: final note: if preemptibles fail at runtime, automatic fallback to smaller batch size will happen (autoscaler policy A23).
